features.name: Composer Slash Keyboard Navigation
features.description: Keep the highlighted slash command visible while navigating a long command list with ArrowDown and ArrowUp, and keep the catalog limited to commands that Sailor can actually execute through its prompt path.

checklist.action: Add a regression assertion in the real Electron Composer fixture that repeated ArrowDown and ArrowUp navigation scrolls the list to the highlighted command and keeps that command inside the visible list bounds.
